entries.instruction: LINE REGISTER, absolute: every line in this frame is drawn at the rig outline weight or heavier. The oven gloves are ONE FLAT UNIFORM colour fill with only the rig-weight outline around them - draw NO quilting, NO crosshatch, NO diamond lattice, NO stitching, NO seam hatching and NO texture strokes on the gloves or anywhere else. No hairline, no micro-pattern, no fine repeated strokes on any garment.
